contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Have an idea for a figurine or a painting? Describe it – I'll reply with a quote and a date.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I have been painting tabletop and RPG miniatures for over ten years – from single heroes to whole armies.
I also paint commissioned pictures: oils, acrylics and watercolours, often inspired by fantasy and night light.
I love dark, moody palettes, careful tonal transitions and details you only notice up close.

steps.title: Request
steps.text: You fill in the form: what you want to achieve, photos or inspirations and a deadline if you have one.

steps.title: Custom quote
steps.text: After your request I prepare a quote and a date tailored to your project.

steps.title: Painting
steps.text: I paint and send progress photos so you can ask for changes.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: The finished work reaches you carefully packed.

privacy.title: Privacy policy

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of your personal data is [full name / company name], [address], who runs the MasterpieceFigurineJ website.

sections.title: What data I collect
paragraphs: Through the order form: your name, e-mail address or phone number, the description of the commission, preferred size and technique (for paintings), deadline and any photos or GIFs you upload.
The website uses no tracking cookies and no analytics tools.

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis
paragraphs: I process the data only to answer your request, prepare a quote and – if we agree – carry out the commission (Art. 6(1)(a) and (b) GDPR).

sections.title: Who receives the data
paragraphs: Form submissions are transmitted and stored by Netlify, Inc. (hosting and form handling), and notifications reach my e-mail inbox. [Add details on transfers outside the EEA and safeguards.]

sections.title: How long I keep the data
paragraphs: Until we finish discussing the commission, and if it goes ahead, for the period required by law [e.g. tax law]. Requests with no further contact are deleted after [e.g. 12 months].

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, to restrict its processing, to data portability and to withdraw consent at any time. You can also lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (in Poland: the President of UODO).
